name: Langflow
description: Visual builder for AI agents and workflows whose flows can be served as APIs or MCP servers.
whatItDoes: Lets developers assemble agents and RAG workflows on a canvas, starting from bundled templates, and deploy them as endpoints. It suits teams that want a visual authoring tool with a Python escape hatch.
howItWorks: Flows are graphs of components (models, tools, retrievers) that Langflow executes and exposes through a built-in API server. Each flow can also be published as a tool through an MCP server. It installs from PyPI, runs in Docker or from source.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Model credentials added in the UI

models: All major LLM providers and local models
